integrity: The dual map and equation are derived from the published normalization parametrization by exact polynomial identities. The unique singular point, its Puiseux pair, global tangent-fiber injectivity, and the absence of smooth flexes are proved symbolically; the accompanying checker is only a replay aid and is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the unique complex four-cuspidal quintic and its projective dual. It does not classify duals of other cuspidal quintics or assert uniqueness of all rational quartics with an \(A_6\) cusp.
title: The dual of the extremal four-cuspidal quintic is an \(A_6\)-cuspidal quartic
